recentItems.title: What Happens When Three Gen Zs Enter A Noughties Social Experiment? | Fresh From The Noughties
recentItems.description:
#NIVEABlackandWhite

3 Gen Z’s enter a social experiment and step back in time to spend the next 48 hours in a millennial mansion. Each Gen Z has their own frustration, which Miquita Oliver’s noughties reset is here to help them with. From lack of confidence in fashion styling, IRL dating and too much reliance on maintaining friendship through social media, they’ll be thrown into different scenarios. As they step back in time, they’ll be handing over their smartphones while picking up fresh new looks with the help of NIVEA Black & White on this confidence-building journey.

Step 1 of the experiment is a style reset with writer and stylist Ayishat Akanbi. What says naughties more than prep style fashion and double denim? Ethan, Emily & Evie take the styling in their stride and spend their first 24 hours getting to know each other naughties style (no phones and no scrolling), just each other's company and some games.

Day 2 is a noughties day out and a chance to take a leap of faith and for Ethan to put his social skills to the rest with some IRL mingling. Arcade in Camden? Perfect set up to meet some new people. The final part of the social experiment focuses on Emily’s frustration of not having too many in-person friendships, which can all be solved with a party and an invite to an old friend.

The end of Miquita’s experiment sees great results: expanded style horizons, more comfortable flirting offline & more of taking the plans out of the group chat, topped off with a new found friendship with each other.
